verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents stakeholder access within its centralized platform and a setting to control shareholder equity value visibility, which implies stakeholders can log in and view their holdings. Its waterfall and round modeling are described as tools for leadership teams, not as employee-facing outcome scenarios. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented employee portal, a grant-level view for employees, vesting progress display, strike price display, employee-facing exit/outcome value modeling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the employee experience.
